_note: Input bindings. Keys use KeyboardEvent.code. Mouse uses `mouse0`..`mouse4`: 0 left, 1 middle, 2 right, 3 thumb-back (nearer the wrist), 4 thumb-forward (further from the wrist). What people call Mouse 4 and Mouse 5 are `mouse3` and `mouse4` here. The scroll wheel is `wheelup` and `wheeldown`: each notch is one press. Scroll down is forward, one tap of W per notch, which is how a scroll tap-strafe works; scroll up is jump, the other common movement bind (a stream of jump presses for bunny hops and superglide timing). `dayNight` (F8) flips SpeedKills between its neon night and its hazy day, to see the city both ways. `inspect` is I (the owner, 2026-09-29: "make I the default inspect key"); it had no key of its own, only a long press of reload with a full magazine, which still works. I was the range's dummy mode, which moved to the full stop (every letter is in use). `keyHints` (/) shows and hides the keys on screen (keyhints.json).
